description: This file defines middleware and utility functions for tenant-aware access control in an Express.js application, including functions to filter queries, apply tenant filters to MongoDB aggregations, and enforce tenant scope in requests.

methods.name: isMongooseQuery
methods.description: Checks if an object is a Mongoose query by verifying presence of 'where' or 'find' methods.

methods.name: filterObject
methods.description: Ensures an object has a tenant_id property set to the given tenantId.

methods.name: filterQuery
methods.description: Adds a tenant_id filter to a Mongoose query if not already present.

methods.name: applyToAggregation
methods.description: Prepends a $match stage with tenant_id to a MongoDB aggregation pipeline if not already present.

methods.name: stampCreate
methods.description: Sets tenant_id on a document before creation, ensuring consistency.

methods.name: tenantScopeEnforcer
methods.description: Express middleware that enforces tenant scope on requests, attaching helper functions to req object.
